title: Your settings
lede: Your language, what Onward Scout may do without asking, how we reach you, and your data.

language.title: Language
language.body: The app, your weekly brief and our emails use this language. Application documents follow the language each opportunity asks for.

authorizations.title: What we may do without asking
authorizations.calloutTitle: Everything here is off until you switch it on.
authorizations.calloutBody: By default nothing is submitted without your tap. If you switch a category on, applications in it are submitted as soon as they are fully prepared and need nothing from you. They are still written only from your own facts, each one still costs 1 credit (reserved first, returned if it fails), and anything that needs you — a CAPTCHA, a login, a payment, a signature, a question your profile can't answer — still comes back to you. Switching off stops it immediately.
authorizations.moreTypes: {count, plural, one {and # more type} other {and # more types}}
authorizations.partial: Some types in this category are on
authorizations.followupBody: When nobody has answered by the follow-up date, send the prepared follow-up without asking first. Off: we still prepare it, for free, and ask for your tap.
authorizations.followupPro: Included with Pro. Your choice is saved and takes effect once you are on Pro.
authorizations.digestBody: Every Monday: new picks, what moved, and what is waiting for your tap. It arrives in your notifications.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.inAppBody: Everything appears in the bell at the top of your board. Always on.
notifications.emailUpdatesBody: When an application needs you, is submitted, or gets a reply.
notifications.emailDigestBody: A copy of your Monday brief in your inbox. Included with Pro.
notifications.mailerOff: Email delivery is not switched on yet, so for now everything arrives here in the app. Your choices are saved for when it is.

integrations.title: Connected accounts
integrations.gmailConnected: Connected as {email}. Outreach is sent from your own mailbox.
integrations.gmailConnectedNoEmail: Connected. Outreach is sent from your own mailbox.
integrations.gmailNone: Not connected. Without Gmail, outreach is prepared for you to send yourself.

data.title: Your data
data.exportBody: One JSON file with everything we store about you: your profile, facts and where each came from, document details, goals, applications, messages, activity, notifications and orders. Uploaded files themselves are in Documents.
data.deleteBody: Erases your profile, documents and files, goals, applications, messages and activity, disconnects Gmail and removes your sign-in. Payment records stay with Stripe; our copy keeps only the amount, without your name or email. This cannot be undone.
data.dialogBody: Everything listed above is erased right away and cannot be recovered. Download your data first if you want a copy.

bell.label: Notifications
bell.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread} other {# unread}}
bell.emptyBody: When an application moves, needs you or gets a reply, you'll see it here.

digest.title: Your week: {parts}

parts.picks: {count, plural, one {# new pick} other {# new picks}}

digest.andMore: {count, plural, one {, and # more} other {, and # more}}
digest.pipelineLine: This week: {submitted, plural, one {# application submitted} other {# applications submitted}}, {replies, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}}, {moved} moving forward.
digest.quietLine: A quiet week: no new picks or replies yet. Your scout keeps looking.
digest.cta: Open your board to review, approve or adjust.

email.why: You get this email because you have an Onward Scout account.

unsubscribe.confirmDigestTitle: Stop the weekly brief by email?
unsubscribe.confirmBody: You will still see everything in the app. You can switch email back on in Settings at any time.
unsubscribe.doneTitle: Done. We won't email you about this anymore.
unsubscribe.doneBody: Everything still arrives in the app. Change it any time in Settings: {url}
unsubscribe.invalidTitle: This link has expired or is not valid
unsubscribe.invalidBody: Open Settings in Onward Scout to choose what we email you.
